description: Shell script for testing CRLF (Carriage Return Line Feed) conversion and related Git autocrlf and safecrlf configurations, including functions for manipulating line endings, applying patches, and verifying file states.

methods.name: has_cr
methods.description: Checks if a file contains CR (Carriage Return) characters.

methods.name: munge_cr
methods.description: Adds or removes CR characters in a file in-place based on argument.

methods.name: cr_to_Q_no_NL
methods.description: Converts CR characters to 'Q' and removes newlines, used for testing line ending conversions.
